33.016.p: C. Trinitarian Guides: The tireless servers of the fifth circle of Havona training for the progressing pilgrims of time and space [26:7.1]. Spiritual graduates are here designated as "candidates for the God adventure" [26:7.1], receiving advanced instruction concerning the divine Trinity [26:7.1]. They assist ascending pilgrims in finding the first accessible personality of the Paradise Trinity [26:7.2].
33.017.p: D. Son Finders: The Supernaphim servers of ascending mortals on the fourth Havona circuit [26:8.2], which is sometimes called the "Son's circuit" [26:8.1]. They prepare candidates to realize the Trinity relationship of the Eternal Son [26:8.2].
33.018.p: E. Father Guides: When a pilgrim soul reaches the third circle of Havona, he is placed under the protection of the Father Guides [26:9.1], who are the oldest, most seasoned, and most experienced Supernaphim servers [26:9.1]. On the worlds of this circuit, the Father Guides conduct schools of wisdom and colleges of technique [26:9.1].
33.019.p: F. Counselors and Advisers: The Supernaphim Counselors and Advisers of the second circle are the teachers of the children of time concerning the life of eternity [26:10.1]. They also act as counselors and helpers to those who fail in their first endeavor to attain God [26:10.2].
33.020.p: G. Rest Regulators: The last order of Secondary Supernaphim assigned to the service of the pilgrims of time on the Havona world circuits [26:10.7], 26:11.1. They provide rich circumstantial environment that they utilize effectively to further the education of ascending pilgrims, especially relating to the problem of adjustment to the many groups of beings soon to be faced on Paradise [26:11.1].
33.022.p: Tertiary Supernaphim derive from the seven Circuit Spirits [26:2.7]. They are the workmen of the Seven Master Spirits, angelic specialists of the various circuits of Havona [26:3.1]. Their service extends to both ascending pilgrims of time and descending pilgrims of eternity [26:3.1].
33.023.p: A. Harmony Supervisors: They originate on the first circuit [26:3.4] and serve throughout all Havona [26:3.4], ensuring harmony in all matters pertaining to maintaining the system and preparing the pilgrims of time for subsequent Paradise attainment [26:3.4].
33.024.p: B. Custodians of Records: These angels are created on the second circuit [26:3.5] but function anywhere in the Central Universe [26:3.5]. They execute the records of Havona's literal files, the spiritual files of their order, and the official Paradise records, recording them in triplicate [26:3.5].
33.025.p: C. Broadcasters: Children of the third circuit spirit [26:3.6], functioning throughout all Havona [26:3.6]. These master technicians are the broadcast receivers and transmitters of the central creation and the responsible cosmic reporters of all divine phenomena on Paradise [26:3.6].
33.026.p: D. Messengers: They originate on the fourth circuit [26:3.7]. They range throughout the Paradise-Havona system as conveyers of all messages requiring personal transmission [26:3.7].
33.027.p: E. Information Coordinators: Children of the fifth circuit spirit [26:3.8]. They are wise and sympathetic promoters of kindred association between the ascending and descending pilgrims [26:3.8]. They serve by keeping all residents of Havona, especially ascenders, currently informed on universe affairs [26:3.8]. They are the "living newspapers" of Havona [26:3.8].
33.028.p: F. Transport Personalities: These beings derive from the sixth circuit [26:3.9]. It is they who carry the disappointed candidates who temporarily fail in the God-seeking adventure [26:3.9]. They are prepared to serve all who enter into the Havona service who are not cosmic transporters [26:3.9].
33.029.p: G. Reserve Corps: They take origin on the guidance worlds of the seventh circle [26:3.11]. They are generated without special design [26:3.11], having the ability to perform service in any of the less strenuous phases of the duties of the supergraphic associates to the Tertiary order [26:3.11].
33.031.p: Seconaphim are the service spirits of the superuniverses [28:0.1]. They are created by the seven Reflective Spirits assigned to the headquarters of each superuniverse [28:3.1]. They are much nearer the Supernaphim than the Seraphim in degree of divinity and Supreme potential [28:0.1]. They are always personalized in groups of seven: one Primary, three Secondary, and three Tertiary Seconaphim [28:3.1], 28:3.1. They reflectively respond to all phases of all creatures originating in the Third Source and Center and the Paradise Creator Sons [28:3.2], but they do not directly reflect beings and realities solely originating in the First Source and Center [28:3.2]. They must also work in pairs to synchronize with the circuit of the Eternal Son [26:1.16].
33.033.p: The Primary Seconaphim assigned to the Ancients of Days are living mirrors serving these Trinity Rulers [28:4.1]. The Ancients of Days can instantly see both sides, hear both ways, and know both ways [28:4.1], 28:4.2. They show tendencies toward seven distinct types of service [28:4.3].
33.034.p: A. Voice of the Cojoint Actor: The first Primary Seconaphim and every subsequent seventh exhibit a high order of adaptability for comprehending and interpreting the mind of the Infinite Spirit [28:4.4]. These Voices are the nearest approach to personal representatives of the Third Source and Center on such a capital sphere [28:4.4].
33.035.p: B. Voice of the Seven Master Spirits: The second Primary Seconaphim and every subsequent seventh tend to exhibit the collective nature and reactions of the Seven Master Spirits [28:4.5]. They are highly capable of representing them before the Ancients of Days [28:4.5].
33.036.p: C. Voice of the Creator Sons: The third Primary Seconaphim and every subsequent seventh are associated with the creation or training of the Paradise Sons of the Michael order [28:4.6]. They have the amazing gift of reflecting the mind of the Creator Son [28:4.6]. In all the history of Uversa, the voice of this Seconaphim has never been known to err in its pronouncements [28:4.7].
33.037.p: D. Voice of the Angelic Corps: The fourth Primary Seconaphim and every subsequent seventh proves to be an angel reacting peculiarly to the sentiments of all orders of angels, including the Supernaphim above and the Seraphim below [28:4.11]. They always provide this sort of unconscious, and therefore certainly unbiased, testimony [28:4.11].
33.038.p: E. Broadcast Receivers: They are not the regular broadcast stations of Uversa [28:4.12]. They work in conjunction with the angelic Voice of Reflectivity for the purpose of synchronizing certain factual messages with the reflective vision of the Ancients of Days [28:4.12].
33.039.p: F. Transport Personalities: These are the Seconaphim who carry the pilgrims of time from the superuniverse headquarters worlds to the outer circuit of Havona [28:4.13]. They are the superuniverse transport corps, operating inward to Paradise and outward to their respective domain worlds [28:4.13].
33.040.p: G. Reserve Corps: Born seven times in succession after the first Primary [28:4.14]. They remain in reserve for unclassified duties and emergency assignment [28:4.14], capable of functioning well in any capacity of associated liaison work [28:4.14].
33.042.p: The Secondary order of Seconaphim are no less reflective than their Primary fellows [28:5.1]. They are deployed in the service of the colleagues of the Ancients of Days: the Divine Counselors, the Perfectors of Wisdom, and the Universal Censors [28:5.2].
33.043.p: A. Voice of Wisdom: Attached to the Perfectors of Wisdom [28:5.3]. Some are permanently connected with the Knowledge Custodians, the living libraries of Paradise belonging to the Primary Supernaphim [28:5.7]. They can segregate and receive the essence of wisdom [28:5.7] and unfailingly transmit these gems of mind action to their superiors, the Perfectors of Wisdom [28:5.7].
33.044.p: B. Soul of Philosophy: Attached to the Perfectors of Wisdom [28:5.3]. When not otherwise directed, they remain synchronized with the Masters of Philosophy on Paradise [28:5.11]. They grasp the reflection of divine wisdom and Paradise philosophy [28:5.11] and assist in the "incarnation" of perfect philosophy for practical application in the lower realms [28:5.11].
33.045.p: C. Union of Souls: A reflector of the ideals and status of ethical relationship [28:5.13], completing the trinitarian staff attached to the Perfectors of Wisdom [28:5.13]. They furnish current information concerning cosmic status [28:5.13] and, simultaneously, show the Paradise ideal of best adjustment to difficult problems [28:5.13].
33.046.p: D. Nucleus of Counsel: The first group placed under the supervision of the Divine Counselors [28:5.15]. This type of Seconaphim holds facts of space selectively conditioned on the material in the circuits of time [28:5.15]. All these have been censored and edited within the advice of the superior minds of Havona and even Paradise [28:5.15].
33.047.p: E. Joy of Existence: Attached to the Divine Counselors [28:5.16]. Their chief activity is directed toward fostering the reaction of joy among the diverse orders of the angelic host and the will creatures below them [28:5.16]. They endeavor to improve the sense of humor and promote the development of transcendent humor among men and angels [28:5.16].
33.048.p: F. Satisfaction of Service: Attached to the Divine Counselors [28:5.17]. They are highly reflective of the attitude of the Director of Conduct on Paradise [28:5.17]. They have done much to illuminate the postponed rewards inherent in unselfish service and in service for the extension of the kingdom of truth [28:5.17]. They contribute greatly to the quality of dedicated service in the superuniverses [28:5.18].
33.049.p: G. Spirit Discerners: The only Seconaphim attached to the Universal Censors [28:5.19], and perhaps the most uniquely specialized beings among all their fellows [28:5.19]. Irrespective of the source or channel of information, they will instantly report to us the true motive, actual purpose, and real nature of its origin [28:5.19]. They face the naked soul of the reflected individual being [28:5.20], continuing this intricate service because of their inherent "spiritual insight" [28:5.20].
33.051.p: All Tertiary Seconaphim are collectively assigned to the Trinity-embraced Sons of Attainment (Mighty Messengers, Those High in Authority, and Those Unnamed) [28:6.1], and these ascending Sons use them interchangeably [28:6.1]. They are time-savers, space-shorteners, error-detectors, and faithful teachers [28:7.3]. They are safe and trustworthy guides for ascending pilgrims from the time of their arrival on the initial mansion worlds until they close their eyes in the Havona sleep preparatory to the Paradise transit [28:7.3].
33.052.p: A. Significance of Origin: The ascending Trinity-embraced Sons of the superuniverse governments are charged with handling all problems arising from the origin of any individual, race, or world [28:6.2]. They are the living reference genealogies of the vast hosts of humans, angels, and other beings who dwell in the seven superuniverses [28:6.4].
33.053.p: B. Memory of Mercy: The visible, adequate, full, and living factual record of how mercifully the Infinite Spirit's workers have ministered to individuals and races [28:6.5]. When judgment is prepared and the books are opened [28:6.6], the unfolding books are the living records, the Tertiary Seconaphim of the superuniverse [28:6.6].
33.054.p: C. Moment of Time: Time is the only universal endowment of all will creatures [28:6.9]. It is the "one talent" entrusted to every intelligent being [28:6.9]. They are always ready to offer testimony proving that every defendant had sufficient time in which to make decisions and achieve choices [28:6.10]. They are also the secret of prophecy [28:6.11].
33.055.p: D. Sanctity of Trust: Trust is the crucial test of will creatures and the true measure of character [28:6.13]. They portray the sense of duty, sacredness, and dignity of the responsibility entrusted to a will creature [28:6.13]. Simultaneously, they unfailingly reflect the exact trustworthiness of any candidate for confidence to the governing authorities [28:6.13].
33.056.p: E. Sacredness of Service: The privilege of serving instantly follows upon being found trustworthy [28:6.16]. They are the index of service [28:6.19], clearly showing a complete analysis of the true motives and hidden impulses [28:6.19]. These angels are truly the mind readers, the heart searchers, and the soul revealers of the universe [28:6.19].
33.057.p: F. Secret of Greatness and Soul of Goodness: Greatness and goodness cannot be readily separated [28:6.21]; they are eternally one with God [28:6.21]. The estimate of greatness differs with spheres [28:6.22]; to be great is to become like God [28:6.22]. Their reflective estimates of greatness and goodness appear inseparable [28:6.21], always presenting a dual and interdependent report [28:6.21].
33.059.p: Tertianaphim are children of the Infinite Spirit [28:1.1], personalized on Paradise in groups of one thousand [28:1.1]. These magnificent beings of divine origin and almost supreme versatility are the gift of the Infinite Spirit to the Creator Sons of God [28:1.1]. They accompany a Creator Son when he sets forth upon the adventure of universe organization [28:1.2]. They are the Creator Son's only personal staff throughout the early building ages of the universe [28:1.3], serving by his side until the personalization of the Bright and Morning Star [28:1.3]. After this, they become liaison officers between the Creator Son of their attachment and the Ancients of Days of the superuniverse concerned [28:1.3], 26:1.13.
33.061.p: Omniaphim are created by the Infinite Spirit in liaison with the Seven Supreme Executives [28:2.1], 26:1.13. They are the exclusive workmen and messengers of these Supreme Executives [28:2.1]. They are occupied with universe business, maintaining headquarters to the north of Uversa [28:2.1]. They are wholly occupied with the supervision of the superuniverses relative to the advantages of administrative co-ordination from the viewpoint of the Seven Supreme Executives [28:2.2]. They are not directly involved in the ascending plan of mortal progression [28:2.1].
33.063.p: The ministering spirits of the local universes, including Seraphim and their assistants, the Cherubim [26:1.14]. They are the offspring of the Universe Mother Spirit [26:1.14]. They make the first contact with ascending mortals [26:1.14]. Seraphim can work alone as individual and localized personalities [26:1.16], but can only enter circuit when polarized in a liaison pair [26:1.16]. Evolved Seraphim can attain the spiritual levels of ascending Sons of God [26:1.10].
33.065.p: The ministering spirits of the local universes, including Seraphim and their assistants, the Cherubim [26:1.14]. They are the offspring of the Universe Mother Spirit, along with the Seraphim [26:1.14]. Some Cherubim aspire to Seraphic status and destiny [26:1.10].
33.067.p: They are born on the inhabited worlds [26:1.14]. Although often functionally associated with the ministering spirits, they are not actually an angelic order [26:1.14]
